statement: At the pinned hid-playstation revision, the Sony USB dongle product 0x0ba0 follows a dedicated one-controller parser. Full USB input report 0x01 uses the second status byte's bit 2 to indicate absence, with disconnected, calibrating, connected and disabled states. Connect schedules calibration; a disconnected or uncalibrated report is not parsed into controller input.

applicability.scope: Sony USB wireless dongle consumer identity, status and conditional input; no physical pairing or slot-count test
